note: Z9X HB (goat_elegant): rows of the stock G0130 tree settings_tree_product_dapengse (gsi/research/hb_stock_decompiled/release_838_newsettings), HAL codes in devices/goat_elegant/research/allowed.tsv, facts in lumen-build-tmp/core-menu/HB_FEATURES.md. Eye protection is one switch (more_eye, type 2: no follow / be-at-ease node in the HB tree). One codename serves G0130 and G0148: the adapter drops boost and picture.color_temp (Standard 0 / Movie 16) at runtime on G0148 and on an unknown model (HbFeatures.modelOff). picture.anti_rbe is the G0148 tree's own row (dapengfhm picture_anti_rbe): the adapter shows it on G0148 only. Stock rows not ported yet, so not named: picture rotation, digital zoom, equalizer, fit to my screen size (HbFeatures PENDING). Stock hint pictures: picture mode, rear projection, fit to screen; the AK one (tips_one_key_correction_diana) waits for a module picture (pending).
